description: From Playa de Los Lances, Tarifa's old town rises behind its medieval walls, the 10th-century Guzmán el Bueno castle dark against the night sky. The broad beach stretches empty in the moonlight, the Atlantic surf glowing softly while the legendary Tarifa wind — blowing about 24 km/h on this clear 23°C night — keeps the air in constant motion. Far across the strait, the faint lights of the Moroccan coast remind you this is the southern edge of Europe.
